summary: Attackers compromised a private key belonging to one signer in a one of three multisignature setup and gained control over the EURR and USDR token contracts. The attacker replaced wallet owners minted large amounts of tokens and swapped them into available liquidity causing approximately two point eight million dollars in losses.
user_mistake: relied on a compromised signer key with sufficient administrative authority over token contracts
prevention: Store multisignature signer keys in hardened isolated environments/Require stronger governance controls for owner replacement actions
